questions.text: 8 men can complete a job in 20 days. 8 women can complete the same job in 32 days. In how many days will 5 men and 8 women together complete the same job?

Karan and Arjun start a business by investing ₹45,000 and ₹50,000, respectively. Karan invests his money for 4 months and Arjun for 10 months. At the end of the year, 20% of the total profit is ₹30,600. What is Arjun’s share of the profit (in ₹)?
